bounded_live_pilot.conclusion: Plain HTTP alone did not validate a viable unauthenticated Lazada acquisition path. Route references in the shell are not commerce evidence. No retry or automatic browser/Edge escalation was performed.

techniques.source_surface: Official Thailand homepage and public category/collection pages
techniques.identity_semantics: Use explicit item/product ID or canonical Lazada item URL; never title-only identity.
techniques.sold_or_order_semantics: Sold and order displays are distinct public counters; neither is a transaction ledger and unclear fields remain unknown.
techniques.ranking_semantics: Position is contextual to the exact page, sort, time, and surface.
techniques.price_semantics: Use an explicit currency display only; preserve unscaled numeric fields as raw provenance.
techniques.browser_or_edge_requirement: plain HTTP first; browser only after reviewed need; Edge not automatically selected
techniques.likely_anti_bot_behavior: May return an application shell or traffic challenge; stop without circumvention.
techniques.stability: Layout and collection routes may change.
techniques.reusability: Generic observation contract reusable; extraction and identity route are Lazada-specific.
assumptions: Public visibility does not authorize recurring collection.
A page position is not a national rank.

techniques.identity_semantics: Explicit public item ID or canonical product URL is required.
techniques.sold_or_order_semantics: Reviews are not sales; sold and orders remain separately typed public counters.
techniques.ranking_semantics: Query-local and sort-local only; personalization may exist.
techniques.pagination_semantics: First response/page and at most 20 records.
techniques.likely_anti_bot_behavior: Search may challenge automation; challenged access returns evidence-withheld.
techniques.stability: Query parameters, rendering, and personalization may change.
techniques.reusability: Marketplace search pattern reusable; request details Lazada-specific.
assumptions: Search ordering is not national bestseller truth.

techniques.source_surface: Visible popular, bestseller, or top-selling sort on a public surface
techniques.url_pattern: Exact official surface and user-visible selected sort
techniques.identity_semantics: Every ranked row needs stable product identity.
techniques.sold_or_order_semantics: Ranking and counter signals are independent.
techniques.ranking_semantics: Strong only within the preserved exact surface/sort/time context.
techniques.price_semantics: Optional display context, not required for ranking identity.
techniques.likely_anti_bot_behavior: Stop on challenge or required authentication.
techniques.stability: Sort names and campaign context may change.
assumptions: Never relabel a contextual rank as Thailand-wide #1.

techniques.source_surface: Official public Lazada Thailand product detail
techniques.url_pattern: Canonical URL containing an explicit item ID such as -i{item_id}-s{sku_id}.html
techniques.identity_semantics: Canonical item ID is primary; SKU may be preserved but does not replace product identity.
techniques.sold_or_order_semantics: Preserve label and raw display; do not equate orders with fulfilled sales.
techniques.ranking_semantics: None unless linked to a separate contextual ranking observation.
techniques.price_semantics: Explicit public currency display only until structured scaling is validated.
techniques.likely_anti_bot_behavior: May challenge; no retries around access control.
techniques.stability: Canonical route and hydration shape may change.
techniques.reusability: Generic product observation reusable; route parser Lazada-specific.

techniques.url_pattern: Official Lazada shop URL and exact visible sort
techniques.identity_semantics: Shop and product identities are separate and both preserved where visible.
techniques.sold_or_order_semantics: Public display only; unknown label means unknown counter type.
assumptions: Shop rank is not marketplace rank.

techniques.source_surface: Structured response directly used by an observed public customer surface
techniques.url_pattern: Discover from bounded public evidence; do not infer private endpoints from names
techniques.identity_semantics: Explicit item/product ID or canonical URL required.
techniques.sold_or_order_semantics: Validate field meaning against visible labels; unknown otherwise.
techniques.ranking_semantics: Array order is not rank without an exact surface/sort contract.
techniques.pagination_semantics: Must be discovered, bounded, and separately reviewed.
techniques.price_semantics: Preserve raw structured price and scaling uncertainty until validated.
techniques.browser_or_edge_requirement: browser discovery candidate only after plain HTTP review; Edge separately decided
techniques.likely_anti_bot_behavior: Do not replay responses requiring cookies, signatures, tokens, or challenges.
techniques.reusability: Structured-response pattern reusable; field mapping Lazada-specific.
assumptions: Lazada Open Platform seller APIs are outside this public explorer.
